_note: "Where the total income of the assessee is chargeable to tax under section 202(1), the provisions of sub-section (1) shall have effect as if for "10%" referred to in clause (b) of that sub-section, "14%" had been substituted" (s.124(2), p.160): an employer other than a Government, in the new regime. Base SALARY (s.124(13)(b)). Survives the new regime (s.202(2)(a)(xii)). TY 2026-27 and TY 2025-26. rulebook DED-NPS-EMP-002, -003. OQ-14. The 1961 counterpart, s.80CCD(2), is the TY 2025-26 version (W-075d1). TY 2025-26: Income-tax Act, 1961 s.80CCD(2), proviso inserted by F(No.2)A 2024 s.25 (p.24, w.e.f. 1-4-2025): "where the total income of the assessee is chargeable to tax under sub-section (1A) of section 115BAC, the provisions of sub-section (2) shall have effect as if for the words "ten per cent." referred to in clause (b), the words "fourteen per cent." had been substituted". sources/2026-10-07-chapter-via.md M15. D-144.

introducedBy.instrumentCitation: Finance (No. 2) Act, 2024 (15 of 2024), s.25 — the proviso reading "ten per cent." in s.80CCD(2)(b) as "fourteen per cent." where the total income is chargeable under s.115BAC(1A)
